body: Air Canada is preparing to launch its longest-ever Boeing 737 MAX 8 route in less than four weeks. Beginning December 13, the Canadian flag carrier will connect Vancouver International Airport (YVR) with Liberia International Airport (LIR) in Costa Rica, covering 3,425 miles (5,512 km). The new service will surpass Montreal–Nantes as the airline's longest MAX route by distance, while the return journey will have a scheduled block time of up to eight hours and 55 minutes.

The route will be operated by Air Canada Rouge, the airline's leisure subsidiary, using its 177-seat Boeing 737 MAX 8, configured with 12 business-class, 18 preferred economy and 147 standard economy seats. The service will operate twice-weekly until April 12, 2027, with three weekly departures during selected periods. Air Canada is transferring its Boeing 737 MAX fleet to Rouge, while moving older Airbus narrowbodies to mainline operations or retiring them; Rouge's fleet will grow from 33 aircraft at the end of 2025 to an eventual all-MAX fleet of 52, with installed seats rising from 5,428 to 9,204, a gain of 70%.

The route will provide another nonstop option for Canadians visiting Costa Rica's Guanacaste region, known for its Pacific beaches and resorts. Air Canada will compete directly with WestJet, which already operates Vancouver–Liberia flights using the MAX 8. The new route follows the opening of Rouge's Vancouver crew base in March this year, supporting the airline's Western Canada expansion. Announcing the fleet transformation, Air Canada's COO Mark Nasr said: "When customers step onto our aircraft, they should instantly feel a sense of comfort, care, and pride."

Beyond Liberia, Edmonton–Montego Bay joins Vancouver–Liberia in December 2026 as Rouge redirects its MAX fleet toward vacation destinations, while mainline receives refurbished Airbus aircraft and introduces the A321XLR for longer international operations, including Montreal–Nantes and Toronto–Shannon.
en.summary: Air Canada will launch its longest-ever Boeing 737 MAX route on December 13, connecting Vancouver with Liberia, Costa Rica, over 3,425 miles; operated by Rouge with a 177-seat MAX 8, the route anchors a fleet transformation that will grow Rouge to 52 all-MAX aircraft with about 70% more seats.
en.title: Air Canada's longest Boeing 737 MAX flights launch in four weeks

body: 加拿大航空將於12月13日開航歷來最長的波音737 MAX航線，連接溫哥華國際機場與哥斯大黎加利比里亞國際機場，全程3,425英里（5,512公里）。新航線每週兩班，至2027年4月12日止，部分期間增至每週三班；去程表定飛行時間7小時20分，回程最長達8小時55分。新航線將超越蒙特婁至南特航線，成為加拿大航空最長的MAX航線，兩者相差98英里。
新航線由加拿大航空休閒子公司Rouge執飛，使用177座波音737 MAX 8，設有12個商務艙、18個優選經濟艙與147個標準經濟艙座位。加拿大航空正把737 MAX機隊移交Rouge，同時將較舊的空中巴士窄體機轉至主線營運或退役；Rouge機隊將由2025年底的33架增至全MAX機隊52架，座位總數由5,428個增至9,204個，增幅約70%。
新航線將與西捷航空直接競爭，後者已使用MAX 8執飛溫哥華至利比里亞航班；此航線亦為加拿大人前往哥斯大黎加瓜納卡斯特地區提供另一不經停選擇，該地區以太平洋海灘與度假勝地聞名。Rouge於今年3月在溫哥華設立機組基地，支援其加拿大西部擴張；加拿大航空營運長Mark Nasr表示，旅客登機時應即感受到舒適、關懷與自豪，這次更新計畫正是要在全網絡始終如一地提供這種感受。
溫哥華至利比里亞之外，Rouge亦將於12月開航艾德蒙頓至蒙特哥貝航線，顯示MAX機隊正轉向度假航線；與此同時，加拿大航空正把空中巴士A321XLR投入部分較長的國際航線，包括蒙特婁至南特與多倫多至香農航線。
zh.summary: 加拿大航空將於12月13日開航溫哥華至哥斯大黎加利比里亞航線，全程3,425英里，為該公司歷來最長的737 MAX航線，由旗下休閒子公司Rouge以177座737 MAX 8執飛；Rouge機隊將逐步全數換裝MAX，座位總數較2025年底增加約70%。
